title: TabDDPM: Modelling Tabular Data with Diffusion Models
summary: A forked tabular-data benchmarking codebase (originally for the TabDDPM diffusion model) that trains and evaluates several tabular synthesizers -- including SMOTE, CTAB-GAN, and CTGAN/TVAE -- as comparison baselines across multiple datasets. The repo vendors the official sdv-dev/CTGAN source in-tree and actually instantiates its TVAESynthesizer to generate baseline synthetic data for evaluation.
needs: CTGAN directory vendors the full sdv-dev/CTGAN package including CTGANSynthesizer, but only TVAESynthesizer is confirmed called in the evidence.
